summary:
All 7 agreed criteria are met. I checked them with the shipped single-file exe (published from this tree) on a real NTFS temp tree. Separate processes held the files open: HoldRig, plus a pwsh appender. Right before the scan the listing said: grow.bin 0 B (its holder reports 314,572,800 / 319,815,680), locked.bin 0 B with share mode 0 (holder: 25,165,824), appended.bin 64 MiB (holder: 134,217,728 / 138,936,320), stale hardlink name 1 MiB (true size 64 MiB). The exe's totals matched the independently computed expectation byte for byte: 548,451,044 bytes and 561,524,840 on disk, 9 files, 8 folders. largestFileOnDisk was 319,815,680, grow.bin's own allocation.

Criterion 5 was made discriminating on the second run. refused.bin was WOF-compressed and given a deny ACE on SYNCHRONIZE and READ_ATTRIBUTES; an ordinary FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES open of it fails with error 5. The exe charged its listing figure (0 on disk, 4,230,000 bytes). Had it read the file's own 20,480, the total would have been 561,545,320.

Criterion 6: HoldRig's handle-only snapshot (a separate process) found all 13 observed entries unchanged, and the three held files were unchanged through their holders' handles. The control folder's last-access time moved 48 h after a plain listing. fsutil reports DisableLastAccess = 2 (updates enabled). This holds under the reading the person chose when M1 was overridden. The scan does refresh the directory listing's cached size of held and stale files: grow.bin went 0 → 314,572,800 and stale.bin 1 MiB → 64 MiB, as measured after the scan.

Code checks: clean rebuild with 0 warnings, 370/370 tests pass, all 56 fitness rules hold.

Real-dataset contact: two whole-C:\ scans through the Release Core Scanner. The warm pass took 170.8 s (listing 98.0 s, sizing 72.8 s), against the spike's sequential 188.3 s and the advisory 150 s bar. It saw 3,735,133 files and made 3,160,361 probes (16,778 corrections, 684 failures, 6 vanished). The longest probe was 14 ms and peak working set 718 MiB. 2,885 of 309,321 folders asked kept their last-access time. Of the 684 failures, 238 are reparse-point files under C:\Users. That is O-028's socket/alias case showing up on this PC, so a C:\ scan would now say "684 files could not be opened".

O-028 to O-031, owed to build-slice, are still not in the tree. Only one build attempt exists, so there is no loop.

criteria.criterion: 1. Size a file another process is actively growing, still listed at 0 B
criteria.how: Shipped exe: grow.bin listed 0 right before the scan; holder handle 314,572,800/319,815,680; exe totals exact and largestFileOnDisk = 319,815,680. HeldOpenTreeTests criterion-1 Fact passes, and the old-rule baseline fails it.

criteria.criterion: 2. Size a file another process appended to after it was already large
criteria.how: Shipped exe: an existing 64 MiB file was opened by a separate pwsh process and grown +64 MiB, unflushed and held. Listing still said 67,108,864; holder 134,217,728/138,936,320; exe totals exact (a listing charge would be 64 MiB short). In-repo ALargeFileHeldOpenAndGrowingIsChargedAtItsTrueSize (in-process) passes.

criteria.criterion: 3. Size a file held open with no sharing at all
criteria.how: Shipped exe: locked.bin (FileShare.None, listed 0) is inside exact totals, where a failed probe would have left 24 MiB uncharged. HeldOpenTreeTests asserts ProbeFailures 0 and passes.

criteria.criterion: 4. Charge a hardlinked file once, at its true size, when the stale name is seen first
criteria.how: Shipped exe: a-first\stale.bin listed 1,048,576, true 67,108,864; totals include 64 MiB once with 9 files. HardlinkTests (2,1)/(3,2)/(2,0) pass.

criteria.criterion: 5. Keep a file at its listing size when its metadata query is refused
criteria.how: Shipped exe: WOF refused.bin with deny (S,RA), whose RA open fails with error 5, was charged at its listing's 0 on disk (561,524,840 total, vs 561,545,320 if probed) and still counted. The rest sized exactly. In-repo test asserts ProbeFailed and ProbeFailures 1. The app's note text was not readable from the report.

criteria.criterion: 6. Leave every file and folder's metadata untouched by the scan
criteria.how: Separate-process HoldRig handle snapshot: 13 back-dated entries unchanged, and 3 held files unchanged via their holders; fsutil recorded. This is the handle reading the person chose over M1. The listing's cached sizes of held and stale files were refreshed by the scan, as measured.

criteria.criterion: 7. Prove the snapshot method detects a real change (control folder)
criteria.how: Control outside the root, plainly listed: atime 2026-09-25 13:31:10Z -> 2026-09-27 13:31:11Z, seen by the same observer; in-repo control Fact passes

criteria.criterion: 8. Suppress a folder's own last-access time while it is listed (FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES + LastAccessTime -1)
criteria.how: All 9 temp-tree folders' atimes unchanged after the exe listed them; LastAccessTests C-008 passes; SynchronousIoCancel.TryOpenKeepingLastAccess read

criteria.criterion: 9. Still list a folder whose ACL refuses the write-attributes open
criteria.how: LastAccessTests.AFolderThatRefusesWriteAttributesIsListedPlainlyAndCountedInFull passes. On real C:\, 306,436 folders took the fallback and unreadable stayed at 674, the same count the spike recorded.

criteria.criterion: 10. Roll a folder's size up from current on-disk bytes, including held-open and hardlinked files
criteria.how: Per folder: HeldOpenTreeTests.EachFolderIsTheOnDiskBytesBelowIt passes (code, real NTFS, external holders). Root: shipped exe totals equal the independent expectation. The exe report has no per-folder figures.

criteria.criterion: 11. Widen the probe rule off the old listing-driven gates
criteria.how: OnDiskSizeTests.ASmallFileWhoseListingSaysNothingIsChargedAtItsOwnSize and HardlinkTests.ALoneNameUnderTheRootIsChargedAtItsOwnSize pass. On real C:\, 3,160,361 probes of 3,735,133 files (cloud-only and later hardlink names excluded).

criteria.criterion: 12. Complete the scan only once every probe result is applied
criteria.how: ProbePassTests.TheScanEndsOnlyOnceEveryProbeIsApplied passes. On real C:\, flaggedProbed 3,159,671 + failures 684 + vanished 6 = probes 3,160,361.

criteria.criterion: 13. Apply an async probe result after an inline correction (hardlink race)
criteria.how: The shape cannot occur once M4 removed the inline probe (declared deviation, accepted at code review). The replacement ProbePassTests.ALaterNameMetBeforeTheFirstNamesProbeIsNeverProbedOrCharged passes in the 370/370 run.

planned.evidence: Shipped exe on a real temp tree: HoldRig created grow.bin and grew it to 314,572,800 (>= 256 MiB) with share Read, held in another process. The listing read 0 B right before the scan. The exe total matched the holder-based expectation exactly, and largestFileOnDisk = 319,815,680 = holder's allocation. HeldOpenTreeTests criterion-1 Fact passes, and fails under the replaced rule.

Checked as written, with a separate process: an existing 64 MiB file was opened by a separate pwsh helper and appended +64 MiB with no flush, held open. Listing 67,108,864; helper handle 134,217,728/138,936,320; exe totals exact, where charging the listing would be 64 MiB short. The in-repo test for this is in-process only.

locked.bin held with FileShare.None by HoldRig, listed 0; the exe's exact totals include its holder-reported 25,165,824/32,505,856, which a failed probe could not produce. The in-repo Fact asserts ProbeFailures == 0.

Links created, file grown through links\b-second\written.bin; the scan meets links\a-first\stale.bin first, listed at 1,048,576. The exe charged the file's current 67,108,864 (allocation 67,108,864) once. HardlinkTests pass.

Deny ACE on SYNCHRONIZE+READ_ATTRIBUTES (an RA open fails with error 5) on a WOF file. The exe kept its listing size (4,230,000 B, 0 on disk rather than its own 20,480), counted it among 9 files, and sized the rest exactly. In-repo test asserts ProbeFailed and ProbeFailures 1. OutcomeNotes text is not in the report schema, so the user-facing note was not read.

A separate process (HoldRig, no Core reference) snapshotted all four times, EOF, allocation and attributes of 13 entries via handles before and after, with 0 diffs. The 3 held files, read via their holders, had 0 diffs. fsutil: DisableLastAccess = 2 (updates ENABLED). The control's atime moved 48 h. This is under the person's M1 override (handle reading). The listing's cached sizes of held and stale files changed (e.g. grow.bin 0 -> 314,572,800), and refused.bin could not be observed.

Per folder: HeldOpenTreeTests.EachFolderIsTheOnDiskBytesBelowIt passes; it computes expectations from holder and snapshot handles while the holders run. At the root: the shipped exe's bytes 548,451,044 and on-disk 561,524,840 equal the independent expectation. The exe cannot show per-folder figures (Q-016).

obligations.evidence: Still open (owed to build-slice). SizeProbe.Probe (src/FsAnalyser.Core/Scanning/SizeProbe.cs:38-61) has no ERROR_CANT_ACCESS_FILE retry with FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, and no AF_UNIX socket test exists. Real impact measured on this PC's C:\: 238 of 684 ProbeFailed entries are reparse-point files under C:\Users.

Still open (owed to build-slice). LastAccessTests has no Offline/cloud-attribute folder Fact and no SMB-LOOPBACK LastAccessAsked == 0 assertion. Separately, I read the remote-gate inputs on the real share Z: (\\100.109.48.75\collab): NTFS, and FileRemoteProtocolInfo answered (0x20000), so the gate logic would refuse keep there. That is not a test.
Still open (owed to build-slice). There is no GetFinalPathNameByHandleW in src/FsAnalyser.Core, and no junction-into-sync-root LastAccessTests case.
Still open (owed to build-slice). .taad/fitness.yaml:706 rule 2 has '\bSetFileAttributes\w*' but no File\.SetAttributes pattern. :735 rule 4's instance pattern lacks GetFiles/GetDirectories.

not_reached: Controlled Folder Access state was not recorded. Get-MpPreference reads a Defender setting kept in the registry, which this run may not read. If CFA is on, a scan of a protected folder (Documents, Desktop, Pictures) makes FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES opens that CFA might block or raise a notification on; nothing tested that.

Probe cost on a network volume (M-add-2) was not measured. The loopback SMB rig needs a person's go-ahead because it changes SMB client mappings. The person's real share Z: was not scanned; I only read its gate inputs.

Whole-drive C:\ was not run in the exact shipped configuration. C:\Users and 16 other non-system top-level folders were passed as SyncRoots so they got no keep-last-access set. So the listing time and the asked/kept counts (309,321 / 2,885) cover the system folders' keep/fallback path only, and the exe itself was not run on C:\.
The user-facing 'N files could not be opened' note (OutcomeNotes) is not in the schema-1 report. Criterion 5's refusal was proven through totals, not through the text the person sees.
Per-folder figures from the shipped exe could not be read, because the report carries only totals (Q-016). Criterion 7 per folder rests on the in-repo test.
Criterion 6 for a refused file: an ordinary-user observer cannot open it under the deny, so its metadata before and after was not compared.
Keep-last-access inside real OneDrive or other sync-engine folders, and the link bypass of the sync-root exclusion (O-030), were not exercised.
Only Windows 11 build 26200 on one NVMe NTFS machine was tested. Windows 10 was not reached, and neither was a controlled cold-cache whole-drive time: the 251.9 s first pass was not a cold boot.

The window's CountersText read '0 files, 0 folders, 0 bytes' at the end of the 9-file scan while the outcome showed 523.0 MB. This is the pre-existing last-tick issue build-slice listed. It was not graded.
